names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Ιουλίου, «Άγιοι Θεόδωρος και Γεώργιος», with the rank word left off. The page gives him no byname; the companionship in the display name is the one thing that distinguishes him.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Θεόδωρος και Γεώργιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο των Αγίων» — no details of the life of the saints. `types` is empty on purpose: the page calls them Άγιοι and nothing more, and its distich says they raised a great trophy against error «εξ άθλων», out of contests, which reads like martyrdom but does not state it; so no rank is asserted. The corpus holds many Theodores and none of them a companion of a George on this day. No year, no century, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
